'''Roarcher Ilran''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A dark-skinned male with short [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Roarcher [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] weapons from their shop in the [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] market. They sported full body [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and spoke fluent [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roarcher appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Republic players on Tatooine.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Roarcher was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> Their position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]], which labeled him as "Roacher Ilran."<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
